name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's passion for motorsport ignited during his youth, attending DTM races with his father at the Norisring. After earning a degree in Communications, he honed his skills at a smaller motorsport team before joining Team Penske. He believes in data-driven PR, meticulously tracking media mentions and engagement metrics to optimize outreach strategies. Klaus-Dieter is known for his direct communication style and unwavering commitment to representing the team in the best possible light.

His time at Penske has seen him manage crisis communications effectively and raise the profile of several drivers. He prides himself on building strong relationships with journalists and influencers, ensuring positive coverage and strategic partnerships. While demanding, he fosters a collaborative environment within his PR team, empowering them to contribute innovative ideas and execute impactful campaigns. He's a firm believer in the power of storytelling to connect fans with the sport and build lasting brand loyalty.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is a man of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and track media mentions.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when under pressure.
Insists on having the latest motorsport news delivered to his desk every morning.
